verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a static-site framework whose features are driven by files, configuration, plugins and a CLI. The evidence shows no documented programmatic API, and no UI-to-API parity claim. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the CLI and plugin architecture are adjacent building blocks, not a documented API matching UI functionality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
